name: qrwise-business-operations
description: Connect your authorized QRWise merchant to explore stores, finalized sales, tax and payment summaries, menus, inventory, orders, discounts, vouchers, register activity, X/Z readings, operational exceptions, kiosk feedback, settlements, and available store-data backups. QRWise provides read-only, merchant-scoped access and does not expose unrestricted database access, customer contact details, payment credentials, or business-data write actions. A QRWise account and an approved connection are required.

defaultPrompt: Which merchant am I connected to, and what stores can I access?
Compare finalized sales across my stores for the last seven business dates.
Show menu, inventory, and integration issues for my selected store.

positive.description: Fresh conversation; use a dedicated QRWise Demo reviewer account scoped only to synthetic demo data. Prepare a store named QRWise Demo and representative records dated October 12-15, 2026. Resolve scope from tools; this fixture has not yet been verified.
positive.prompt: Which merchant am I connected to, and what stores can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_merchant with no arguments and list_stores with offset=0. Identifies merchant QRWise Demo, follows next_offset until null, and lists only stores returned for that merchant. Does not reuse another merchant or invent a store count.

positive.description: Fresh conversation; use a dedicated QRWise Demo reviewer account scoped only to synthetic demo data. Prepare a store named QRWise Demo and representative records dated October 12-15, 2026. Resolve scope from tools; this fixture has not yet been verified.
positive.prompt: For QRWise Demo, summarize finalized transaction sales from October 12 through October 15, 2026, including the daily breakdown.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the QRWise Demo store through list_stores, then calls get_transaction_sales with dateFrom=2026-10-12, dateTo=2026-10-15 and includeDaily=true. Reports the returned paid transaction count and sales_amount, gross_amount, net_amount, discounts and service_charge under their correct labels. Daily rows match the response and reconcile to the corresponding totals. Does not substitute recorded readings or infer zero sales for missing dates.

positive.description: Fresh conversation; use a dedicated QRWise Demo reviewer account scoped only to synthetic demo data. Prepare a store named QRWise Demo and representative records dated October 12-15, 2026. Resolve scope from tools; this fixture has not yet been verified.
positive.prompt: For QRWise Demo, show menu issues, integration status, and inventory activity from October 12 through October 15, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the QRWise Demo store through list_stores. Calls get_menu_health and get_integration_health for that store and get_inventory_activity with dateFrom=2026-10-12, dateTo=2026-10-15 and limit=20. Reports only returned issues and integration statuses. Inventory movement uses the requested Asia/Manila calendar dates; current menu health and stock levels are identified as current, not historical snapshots. Performs no mutation.

positive.description: Fresh conversation; use a dedicated QRWise Demo reviewer account scoped only to synthetic demo data. Prepare a store named QRWise Demo and representative records dated October 12-15, 2026. Resolve scope from tools; this fixture has not yet been verified.
positive.prompt: For QRWise Demo, summarize X- and Z-reading activity and include individual shift-reconciliation rows for business dates October 12 through October 15, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the QRWise Demo store through list_stores. Calls get_reading_activity with readingType=ALL, dateFrom=2026-10-12, dateTo=2026-10-15 and limit=100, then get_shift_reconciliation with the same dates and includeDaily=true. Reports X/Z counts from returned totals and shift rows from the response. Uncounted shifts retain null counts and variance; no balanced status or missing variance is inferred. Does not add overlapping X and Z sales into a finalized sales total.

positive.description: Fresh conversation; use a dedicated QRWise Demo reviewer account scoped only to synthetic demo data. Prepare a store named QRWise Demo and representative records dated October 12-15, 2026. Resolve scope from tools; this fixture has not yet been verified.
positive.prompt: For QRWise Demo, list all Netbank settlements created in Asia/Manila from October 12 through October 15, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the QRWise Demo store through list_stores, then calls list_settlements with dateFrom=2026-10-12, dateTo=2026-10-15 and offset=0. Follows next_offset until null. Reports only returned amounts and statuses, using Asia/Manila payout creation dates. Exposes no bank details, credentials or another merchant records. If the fixture has no payouts, reports that limitation rather than inventing settlements.
